title: 词典 K
html:
词典 K

概述

本页收录以字母 K 开头的实用词汇，涵盖职场、日常和技术三大场景。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，另设补充词汇、常用短语与学习提示，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

职场与商务

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
KPI n. 关键绩效指标 meet KPIs The team exceeded all KPIs this quarter.
keen adj. 渴望的；敏锐的 keen on / keen interest She is keen on taking on more responsibilities.
kickoff n. 启动；开球 project kickoff The project kickoff meeting is scheduled for Monday.
knack n. 诀窍；天赋 have a knack for He has a knack for solving complex problems quickly.
know-how n. 专业知识；实际技能 technical know-how Her technical know-how makes her invaluable to the team.
keynote n. 主旨演讲；基调 keynote speech The CEO delivered the keynote speech at the annual summit.
key takeaway n. 关键要点 the key takeaway The key takeaway from the meeting is that we need more testing.

日常与社交

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
keep v. 保持；继续 keep in touch / keep going Let's keep in touch after the conference.
kind adj./n. 善良的；种类 kind of / a kind gesture That was a very kind gesture from your neighbor.
knowledge n. 知识；了解 general knowledge A broad knowledge base is essential for this role.
knit v. 编织；紧密结合 closely knit They are a closely knit community that supports each other.
kudos n. 荣誉；赞扬 give kudos to Kudos to the design team for the amazing work!
kid n./v. 孩子；开玩笑 just kidding I was just kidding, don't take it seriously.
kindle v. 点燃；激发 kindle enthusiasm The speaker's words kindled enthusiasm in the audience.
kin n. 亲属；亲戚 next of kin Please list your next of kin on the emergency form.
knack n. 本领；窍门 have a knack for cooking She has a real knack for cooking Italian food.

技术相关

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
kernel n. 内核 Linux kernel The Linux kernel handles hardware communication.
key n./adj. 键；关键的 primary key / API key Never expose your API key in client-side code.
Kubernetes n. 容器编排平台 deploy on Kubernetes We migrated our services to Kubernetes last month.
keystroke n. 击键；按键 capture keystrokes The app logs keystrokes for shortcut customization.
kilobyte n. 千字节 file size in kilobytes The configuration file is only a few kilobytes.
Kafka n. 分布式消息队列平台 Kafka cluster We use a Kafka cluster for real-time event streaming.
Kotlin n. Kotlin 编程语言 write in Kotlin Android development has shifted to Kotlin as the preferred language.
key-value adj. 键值对的 key-value store Redis is a popular key-value store for caching.

补充词汇

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
kit n. 工具包；套件 starter kit / toolkit The SDK includes a starter kit for new developers.
knockout n./adj. 淘汰；出色的 knockout round Their demo was a knockout at the tech fair.
keen-eyed adj. 目光敏锐的 keen-eyed reviewer A keen-eyed reviewer caught the critical bug before release.
knowledgeable adj. 知识渊博的 knowledgeable about She is very knowledgeable about cloud architecture.
kinetic adj. 运动的；动力学的 kinetic energy The animation uses kinetic scrolling for a smooth user experience.
kiosk n. 自助终端；信息亭 self-service kiosk The airport has self-service kiosks for check-in.

常用短语

短语 含义 例句
keep track of 跟踪；记录 Use this dashboard to keep track of all active tasks.
keep up with 跟上；保持同步 It's hard to keep up with the latest JavaScript frameworks.
kick off 开始；启动 Let's kick off the sprint planning session.
key in 输入（数据） Please key in your password to proceed.
knock out 快速完成 We managed to knock out the feature in a single day.
keep an eye on 关注；留意 Keep an eye on the server metrics during the deployment.
know inside out 了如指掌 She knows the codebase inside out after three years on the project.

学习提示

  • KPI 是职场中最常提及的缩写之一，了解如何围绕 KPI 进行工作汇报非常重要。
  • kickoff 在敏捷开发中常用，指项目或冲刺的启动会议。
  • Kubernetes 简称 K8s，是云原生技术栈的核心，技术面试高频词。
  • key 在技术语境中含义丰富：数据库主键、API 密钥、加密密钥等，需根据上下文区分。
  • keep up with 是描述持续学习的经典搭配，适用于技术社区和职业发展语境。
  • key-value 是 NoSQL 数据库和缓存系统中最基础的数据模型概念。
  • Kafka 是大数据领域的明星项目，掌握其基本概念有助于理解事件驱动架构。
  • kudos 源自希腊语，在 Slack 和团队沟通中常用于表达对同事的公开赞赏。
  • kernel 是操作系统的核心组件，理解内核概念有助于排查底层性能问题。
  • knowledgeable 常用于推荐信和绩效评语中，描述某人在特定领域的专业程度。
  • kit 在开发语境中常见于 SDK（Software Development Kit），指一套开发工具集合。
  • kiosk 在零售和自助服务场景中广泛使用，了解这个词有助于理解 IoT 相关讨论。
